name: Sitagliptin
description: A dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor that raises endogenous incretin levels, approved for type 2 diabetes. Renally cleared with labelled dose reduction in renal impairment.

systems.note: Incretin degradation blocked, raising endogenous GLP-1; the labelled indication.
Renally cleared; dose reduction is labelled in renal impairment.
Severe joint pain is labelled for the class.

monitors.why: Pancreatitis is labelled for the class.
